user.title: Create a room rule
user.description: Choose a Home Assistant area and its presence binary sensor. Select Submit to continue to a second step. The area only filters the choices there: ONLY entities you explicitly select in that step will be controlled.

data_description.name: Usually the room name or the room and person's name.
data_description.area_id: Only switchable entities assigned to this area will be offered next; choosing the area does not select them.
data_description.presence_entity: The binary sensor must be on while presence is detected and off when the room is empty. Shelly sensors are supported through their regular Home Assistant entity.

targets.title: Choose what to turn off
targets.description: Select the entities this rule may control. Unselected entities are NEVER touched, including other entities in this area and entities added to it later. A selected Home Assistant group can control all its members, so select a group only if every member should be controlled.

data_description.target_entities: The Add dropdown shows available candidates, not selected targets. An entity is controlled only after you add it to the selected list.

conditions.title: Delay, day conditions, and restoration
conditions.description: Shabbat and holiday sensors are optional when every day type is allowed. Holiday takes priority when both are on. For one combined ‘Shabbat or holiday’ sensor, use the Shabbat field and leave Holiday empty. An unavailable configured day sensor blocks a day-restricted shutdown or restoration.

data.restore_on_presence: Restore previous state when presence returns

data_description.delay: How long the room must remain empty before entities are turned off.
data_description.shabbat_entity: On means Shabbat/special day; off means an ordinary day unless Holiday is on.
data_description.holiday_entity: On means holiday and overrides the Shabbat sensor.
data_description.allowed_day_types: These day types gate shutdown and restoration. A blocked shutdown waits while the room is empty; restoration is checked once when presence returns and only runs if currently allowed.
data_description.restore_on_presence: When enabled, the rule saves the state of selected entities at shutdown and restores only entities that it successfully turned off. Restoration also requires the current day type to be allowed.

error.no_supported_entities: No entities with a turn-off action are assigned to this area. Assign devices to the area in Home Assistant and try again.
error.invalid_delay: Choose a delay between 0 seconds and 30 days
error.day_type_required: Select at least one day type
error.same_gate_entity: Choose different sensors for Shabbat and holiday
error.gate_required: Choose a Shabbat/holiday sensor, or allow all day types
error.entity_not_found: The selected entity no longer exists. Choose it again.
error.target_not_allowed: Choose only entities from this room that support turn off.
